uslaw-usc-t2-s9:
Section 9 of Title 2 of the United States Code sets how votes for Representatives in Congress must be cast. Title 2 covers Congress, and this section sits in the chapter on election of senators and representatives. The hosted text is the version current in twenty twenty six. It is a short, strict ballot rule.

All votes for Representatives must be by written or printed ballot, the text states. A voting machine whose use has been duly authorized by state law also counts as valid. All votes received or recorded contrary to this section are of no effect. Oral or informal votes for the House thus have no legal standing at all.
